meta.title: Thinking modes
meta.description: Divergent (minimum low), focused (minimum high), thorough (strictly max), and automatic phase switching. Thorough mode investigates root causes, tests assumptions and counterexamples, and cross-checks evidence. Choose Thinking mode in the model menu or use /thinking auto, divergent, focused, thorough, off. Thorough requires declared max support; high/xhigh are not substitutes. Turning the module off restores its previous effort selection.
